title: Prestige Group — Depth & Specificity Research
content:
Prestige Group is a leading real estate developer in India, offering residential, commercial, retail, hospitality, and rental properties. They have completed over 195 projects since their inception in 1986 and are currently developing more than 70 million square feet, which some claim is the largest in Asia. They have implemented Therefore™ for document retrieval, creating an electronic filing system and planning to add more functionalities like automated workflow and document approval cycle. The company has no SaaS offerings and operates in both B2B and B2C markets.
